description: One collapsible section of an inspector form (redesign 146c7e1b, phase 6): a chevron disclosure button over a body, no frame. The body stays in the DOM while the section is folded (the hidden attribute), so a control inside keeps its state and its test id. The image inspector and the table / cell panels are built from it.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Section title, the label of the disclosure button.

parameters.name: Icon
parameters.description: Optional decorative icon between the chevron and the title.

parameters.name: SectionTestId
parameters.description: Unprefixed test id of the section root; the disclosure button gets the same id plus -toggle.

parameters.name: DefaultExpanded
parameters.description: Whether the section starts unfolded. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes on the section root.

parameters.name: OnExpandedChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the reader folds or unfolds the section.
